notes.title: 🧾 New Update: Discounts & Easier Pricing!🪩
notes.notes:
Hey store managers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/d09656a2db71dff2f348a0b8e1a926380972f79f.png

A fresh update just dropped in Clothing Store Simulator. It’s all about giving you more control over your sales strategy.

🛍️ Run Item-Specific Discounts
You can now apply discounts to individual products!
Want to boost sales on a slow seller or highlight a featured item? Set a custom discount and watch the customers rush in.

🖱️ Edit Prices from the Shelf
No need to run back to your PC - just update the price directly from the item’s tag on the shelf.
Quick, easy, and super handy during busy hours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/9809f589a8f98e45cd2e539e53e93969436e6871.gif

💬 Got thoughts on the update? Drop your feedback in the community hub – we’re always listening and planning what’s next!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/0003e180836d068c185e81747eb3d1ada0e8f938.png

Thanks for playing, and as always…
Happy selling! 👚🧵💸

notes.title: Seasonal Update 🌞❄
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/42de9481dd3a6f2d67a8a6baea2e7aa195386032.png

🌟 Seasonal Update is Here! 🌞❄

Are you ready for a whole new season in your Clothing Store? With the new update, summer and winter seasons will rotate, bringing exciting changes to your shop. 🌸❄

Seasonal Categories
Clothing is now categorized by season: Summer clothes for the hot days, and winter clothes for the chilly days. Each season, customers will search for specific items, and you will be the best seller with the right products! 🛍🔥
Make sure you're stocked up on the hot items for each season! 

The new seasons are waiting! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Kids’ Department Update / Clothing Store Simulator
notes.notes:
Greetings, managers!

With this update, you’ll have to cater to a whole new audience - children! The kids’ department is now open, so let’s see what’s inside! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/e31ee379ad6b22800de80e1c8addc5a472fc2949.png

Major Changes

You can now sell clothes for children!

Our managers have been asking for this for a long time, so it’s finally time to expand the range of clothes that we sell to fit (ha-ha, get it?) a new audience. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/3db18d7017cace11491fdfbf7edf09f66e9b3d4e.gif

With this major update, our managers get access to 4 new brands that specialize in children’s clothing:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/59437b6755bb4ac4af4aa1bccb84cf8ee16a4adb.gif

And to 6 new appropriately-sized mannequins to showcase it: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/ce238c63449959bc9deead811b486297d8880632.png

Other Updates & Changes

 Items from previous seasons of the Clothing Pass can now be purchased with in-game money instead of Kiki Coins. 


We can’t wait to see how you will adjust your beautiful stores to fit the new section and we hope you’ll enjoy the variety of clothes included in this update.

Speaking of your beautiful stores, have you seen the latest Clothing Store Simulator trailer made possible by our amazing community and their creative stores? 
[previewyoutube=s4PF19G0oBg;full][/previewyoutube]


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/0fa2638c74a91440c716b28d36e6462abe14e319.png

Have fun in the new update, managers, and we can’t wait to show you the next one we’re working on - it will be focused on making your experience in Clothing Store Simulator much smoother! 

Meanwhile, If you want to meet other up-and-coming clothing store managers like yourself, why don’t you join our Discord server? There, you can chat about clothes, stores, and everything in between. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c0fa8507e36ca86fa1dc3b25bab699084805deb8.png

See you next time!

notes.title: Online Orders Update / Clothing Store Simulator
notes.notes:
Greetings, managers!

We’re excited to finally open the doors of the Post Office that’s been teasing you every time you left your stores! So let’s get into the details of the update!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/eceb2634c82b27d40915f8fe1e8ea51c2f776e14.png

Major Changes

Online Orders are now in the game! 

When you update the game, you’ll see the ‘Online Orders’ tab on your in-game computers after you reach level 20. Press it to find a multitude of people too busy to go to your stores on foot but still want a fresh set of clothes! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/8f176ab8ec21b55f34e3a3aae8d52a8f82998407.gif

Accept the orders that you want and start collecting clothes from your shopping area and the Warehouse!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/8fdaf6279855032b1882a41b0606f4ef881441e1.gif

When an online order is active, press TAB to check what items you need to collect!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/4a68e0997055dc60e6380905e1d60caabd764bb2.gif

To send the online order, just bring all the required clothes to the Post Office and put them in the box! Done! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/48d10a9e46d4d841b8184a6f0f2f55991ef2a41c.gif

Changes & Updates

 Font Import system added. You can now import your favorite fonts to put on your Special Designs. 
 Cart Increased. You are now able to place 20 items in the order cart instead of 15.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/0fa2638c74a91440c716b28d36e6462abe14e319.png

We hope that you like this update! We continue to work on the game to bring more gameplay elements, optimizations, and changes, so you’ll be hearing from us pretty soon about what’s coming to Clothing Store Simulator next!

Meanwhile, If you want to meet other up-and-coming clothing store managers like yourself, why don’t you join our Discord server? There, you can chat about clothes, stores, and everything in between. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c0fa8507e36ca86fa1dc3b25bab699084805deb8.png

See you next time!

notes.title: Clothing Pass Update - Hotfix
notes.notes:
UI Changes

 Additional information was added to Daily Rewards in the Clothing Pass.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed the issue that required some players to repurchase the Clothing Pass after restarting the game.
 Fixed the issue of money received from customers left in the store at the end of the day not being displayed correctly in the report.

notes.title: Clothing Pass Update - Clothing Store Simulator
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players!
We are happy to introduce the new Major Update for Clothing Store Simulator.

Introducing Clothing Pass - a system that will keep the game fresh even for the most seasoned players!  Earn XP to rank up in the Pass and unlock unique rewards. Don't forget to visit the Clothing Pass Market down the street from your shop to spend your rewards on exclusive clothing and furniture that's updated daily!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/826c84d2dbecbdc11e785e7e981bb9d7bdb1d1b4.png

Changes and Additions:

 Clothing Pass system added.
 1 new wall added.
 8 new shelves added.
 6 new mannequins added.
 Save backup system added.
 Customizable shoes added. (Unlockable with Clothing Pass)
 A special market for Clothing Pass has been added. Here, 5-6 different items or products will be sold daily.
 When customers are in the store at the end of the day, and you press the "N" key, products will no longer fall to the ground. Products will be sold, and the money will be added to your account.
 The leaderboard ban system has been improved.
 The construction system has been improved.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/f4cb78b983384f353ccdf3c12d0c244dd5770b31.png

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the issue causing a glitch when moving storage shelves.
 Fixed the issue of customers wearing design clothes twice.
 Fixed the issue where customers would remain in front of the checkout at the start of a new day.
 Fixed the issue of not being able to move the warehouse shelf after selling the warehouse box

notes.title: Leaderboard Update & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Managers! Are you ready for another update? 

Changes

 Leaderboard Rework. Now, cheaters won't appear in the rankings. We're all honest store managers here, and we want to celebrate actual dedication and skill, not cheats! As a result, Customer satisfaction ranking will be reset.


Bug Fixes

Fixed employee issues.
Fixed customer issues.
Fixed cashiers not adding money to the screen after 10 items.
Solved the problem of employees buying 1 more product.
Solved the problem of employees not standing up from their seats.
Fixed N key press issue in pause and feedback UI.
Fixed the issue with the 'Crouch' button working during Store Sign editing.
Solved the problem of Restockers not filling some shelves.

notes.title: BUG FIX

-Employee system has been improved.

-Feedback UI is added.

notes.title: Stocker and Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hello dear players, here is our update content:

-Cashier UI index error is fixed.
-The problem of products staying in the air in our hands while buying them is fixed.
-Employees were not taking the clothes thrown by customers. This problem is fixed. 
-The problem of employee's continuous waiting in idle position is fixed.
-Employee sitting with products in hand is fixed.
-Employee system is improved.
-Now, employees will tire more slowly.
-The system of placing storage boxes on storage shelves has been changed. Now we can snap the boxes.
-When moving storage shelves, sometimes some storage boxes did not come with the storage shelf. This is fixed.
-Now, employees work in aisle will wear the designed employee clothing.
-Outline will now appear on the storage box if the last item we carry is the same as the item in the storage box.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/91bfd921ebf296045a301895b9d6b37026fa807c.png

-Restocker's getting tired time: 150 seconds ----> 400 seconds 
-Restocker's speed: 0.75-1.25 ----> 1-1.25
-Now, to make restockers more efficient, they will start working after half of the clothes on the shelf are gone.

notes.title: Restockers Update - Clothing Store Simulator
notes.notes:
Hello, shoppers and managers!

You've been asking us about this feature since the Prologue release, so we're happy to tell you that... 

Restockers are here!

This new type of NPC Worker will help you organize your shop efficiently!

Are you running out of clothes on the shelves while there's some stock left in the Warehouse? Restockers will help!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/c840bdace463a259060c8d95de5d9de0d4c08713.png

Workers should rest when they get tired. Don't forget to buy chairs to them so they can rest!

Rude customers are throwing clothes all over your store? Restockers will help and put them back on the shelves!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/3da6743143ce7892d37e7cbc3fd696137d2f86a2.gif

The addition of Restockers will allow you to focus on other tasks while they monitor your stock closely! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/a0f0727d614a30a4a28d40cc061e055be05b3076.png

Now, you can leave flowers in front of store, too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/05c3f14ada708dc1af066cce1d191b6c96597702.png

Don't forget to join Discord to leave your suggestions and feedback for future updates and talk directly to the team!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013905/c0fa8507e36ca86fa1dc3b25bab699084805deb8.png

notes.title: Update - 20.06.2024
notes.notes:
Hello, shoppers and managers! 

We continue to read your feedback, suggestions ang bug reports to make Clothing Store Simulator even better! Today’s update contains some changes and bug fixes to improve your experience!

Updates & Changes

 Storage Tab. You can now see "Storage" tab on furniture section of the in-game computer! (You should find warehouse stuff easily since you'll need the extra space for all of the new clothes coming in the next updates!)
 Added Visual Markers to indicate the best places for your clothes in the aisles. You can switch them on or off in the Settings menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/85e2ee5ca3698fa0e4e3046ad89d9f1ad7a90fab.gif

 The name of your Clothing Store will now be written on your own Special Designs. Fancy!


Bug Fixes

 We’ve optimized all of the clothes in the game.
 We’ve fixed the annoying FPS drop issue connected to the Wholesale.
 We fixed bugs in the NPC's behavior in front of cash register. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013904/0fa2638c74a91440c716b28d36e6462abe14e319.png
While this is a small update, we continue to fix bugs and work on major features! Stay tuned!

notes.title: BUG FIX UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello dear players, your support makes us very happy. Thank you for everything.
We are working on the bugs you reported to us and the things you want to be balanced. The Stock and Store attendant you all asked for will be coming soon.
These are the topics we fixed with this update:

-Fixed an issue with incorrect shoe image in the shipping box
-The problem of expensive shoes solved
-Solved the problem of not being able to pick up products on the ground
-Fixed an issue with the button to open the -Boya shop
-Environmental sound and footstep sound settings have been added to the settings.
-Fixed the issue of not unlocking the warehouse achievement on the first level.
-Fixed the issue where the customer was stuck in front of the shelf and the same animation kept playing.
-News updated
-Updated late UI to new day
-and general bug fix.
